items.title: Making sense of Python parentheses, brackets, and braces
items.summary:
Get better at Python, one short lesson a week — my free Better Developers newsletter: https://lernerpython.com/become-a-better-developer/?ref=yt-desc

It's confusing enough that Python uses three types of parentheses — (), [], and {}. It's even more confusing that each of these is used in a number of different contexts.

In this video, I walk you through the different types and uses of parentheses you need in Python, and when they're each used.

items.title: 🔴 LIVE: DRDO Approves Tech Transfer for Conventional Missiles | TCS Buys MHP for €320M | Front Page
items.summary:
India has approved the transfer of technology (ToT) for all conventional missile systems—including Akash, Pinaka, Pralay, and QR-SAM—from DRDO to private domestic industries to accelerate mass production and boost MSME participation. In corporate news, TCS acquired Porsche's IT subsidiary MHP for €320 million alongside a multi-year deal, while Home Minister Amit Shah directed security agencies to adopt AI for national security analysis. Meanwhile, Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw highlighted Made-in-India chips powering space missions, Anthropic urged candidates to prioritize AI safety over money, and Sonar's JX Wee joins us live to discuss code security.   

This is your Front Page LIVE, bringing you sharp analysis of the biggest technology, business, policy and economic stories shaping India and the world.

items.title: Why General-Purpose LLMs Fall Short in Business
items.summary:
A general-purpose LLM can produce impressive answers, but real business problems demand domain knowledge, reliable outputs, and behavior tailored to a specific workflow.

In this Short, an author of Building Specialized AI Systems explains why off-the-shelf models are often only the starting point—and how specialization can turn a capable model into a useful business system.

Learn more about Building Specialized AI Systems: https://hubs.la/Q04tZN370
